hero.title: Connecting Africa to unlimited possibilities
hero.description: AfricaConnect4 is the fourth iteration of an EU-funded initiative growing Africa's research and education sector through high-speed connectivity, climate data infrastructure, digital services and capacity building implemented in West and Central Africa by WACREN.

cards.title: Connectivity Expansion
cards.description: Strengthening the WACREN backbone, extending high-speed regional links and tackling last-mile gaps bringing new countries into the network in Phase 4.

cards.title: Climate Data Infrastructure
cards.description: HPC clusters, EUMETCast terrestrial data portals, WMO-compliant weather stations and LoRaWAN gateways building the digital plumbing for African climate research, all under the WACREN CLIMET service.

cards.title: Women in STEM
cards.description: Growing women's leadership through the Women-in-WACREN programme, annual hackathons and mentorship.

cards.title: Cybersecurity & Threat Intelligence
cards.description: Standing up an ISAC, strengthening CSIRT cooperation and securing federated identity across the region's NRENs, through the TrustBroker Africa and the WACREN T&I programmes

cards.title: Capacity Building
cards.description: The NREN Academy, business accelerators, technical training and exchange programmes equipping a new generation of African REN leaders, all through the Africa Training Initiative (ATI).

stats.title: Building on the success of three earlier phases.

aboutIntro.title: What is AfricaConnect4?
aboutIntro.para1: AfricaConnect4 (AC4) is an EU-co-funded pan-African connectivity project that consolidates and expands on the results of three previous phases, together supporting the creation, development and use of high-capacity research and education networks across the continent.
aboutIntro.para2: The project's overall objective is to increase African research and education communities' access to and use of information and communications technology, and to strengthen international cooperation on science, technology and innovation to address global challenges.
objectives: Enhance the delivery capacity and the financial and institutional sustainability of African Regional and National Research and Education Networks.
Ensure African R&E communities' access to affordable, reliable, high-speed connectivity, and connection to the global R&E community.
Strengthen the delivery of above-the-network services, with particular focus on e-learning, climate change science and related disciplines.

connectivity.heroDesc: Growing regional network infrastructure to connect the unconnected.
connectivity.lead: A robust and expansive network is the foundation of digital transformation across West and Central Africa.
connectivity.para: Through the AfricaConnect4 project, we are significantly expanding the reach of our high-speed network. By deploying new links and upgrading existing ones, we aim to bridge the digital divide, providing researchers, educators, and students with reliable and fast internet access.
connectivity.card1Desc: Enhancing backbone capacity and resiliency across member countries to handle future data demands.
connectivity.card2Desc: Establishing vital direct connections with international research networks and major content providers.

climate.heroDesc: Building data systems supporting climate resilience.
climate.lead: Empowering the region with the digital infrastructure needed to monitor, analyze, and combat climate change effectively.
climate.para: Climate research requires immense computational power and data storage. The AfricaConnect4 initiative provides dedicated infrastructure and high-speed transit for earth observation data, enabling local scientists to collaborate globally and develop data-driven climate resilience models tailored for the region.
climate.card1Desc: Creating centralized, accessible hubs for regional environmental data and historical climate records.
climate.card2Desc: Providing the high-throughput connectivity needed for real-time weather tracking and disaster early warning systems.

women.lead: Driving systemic change by empowering and increasing the representation of women in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
women.para: The Women-in-STEM initiative within AfricaConnect4 focuses on creating pathways, mentorship opportunities, and leadership programs. We aim to break down barriers, providing female researchers and engineers with the resources and platforms necessary to thrive in the digital ecosystem.
women.card1Desc: Connecting young female professionals with established leaders for guidance, sponsorship, and career development.
women.card2Desc: Specialized workshops aimed at equipping women with the skills necessary to take on executive roles in NRENs.

cybersecurity.heroDesc: Strengthening regional cyber resilience and threat intelligence.
cybersecurity.lead: Safeguarding academic and research networks against evolving digital threats.
cybersecurity.para: As connectivity expands, so does the attack surface. Our cybersecurity focus works to build robust defense mechanisms across the regional network. By fostering collaboration between National Research and Education Networks (NRENs), we establish shared threat intelligence and rapid incident response protocols.
cybersecurity.card1Desc: A unified platform for member institutions to report vulnerabilities and share real-time threat signatures.
cybersecurity.card2Desc: Implementing secure authentication federations like eduroam and eduGAIN across the WACREN region.

capacity.heroDesc: Training and institutional development for the future.
capacity.lead: Equipping engineers, researchers, and institutions with the skills required to sustain digital growth.
capacity.para: Infrastructure alone is not enough. The Capacity Building initiative focuses on continuous education, hands-on workshops, and institutional support. We train network engineers on modern routing protocols, and assist researchers in utilizing high-performance computing services.
capacity.card1Desc: Comprehensive bootcamps on cloud deployment, network management, and advanced routing strategies.
capacity.card2Desc: Providing strategic consulting to emerging National Research and Education Networks on sustainability models.

openScience.heroTitle: Open Science and Open scholarly communication infrastructure
openScience.lead: Open, equitable access to African research is central to the region's digital transformation.
openScience.para: Through the AfricaConnect4 project, WACREN advances this agenda via LIBSENSE, a WACREN-led programme building a community of practice for open science and progressing the adoption of open science services and infrastructures across Africa.

activities.heroDesc: Conferences, workshops, hackathons, training sessions and community meetings across the AfricaConnect4 programme in West and Central Africa.

aboutTimeline.title: Building on a decade of progress
aboutTimeline.subtitle: The European Commission has supported African research and education networks (RENs) through the AfricaConnect programme since 2011. WACREN joined the project in the second phase (AfricaConnect2 - 2015 - 2019).
aboutTimeline.card2Desc: Launched the WACREN backbone, connecting the NRENs of Nigeria, Ghana and Togo to GÉANT.
aboutTimeline.card3Desc: Extended connectivity to six new countries and opened a new Dakar aggregation hub.
aboutTimeline.card4Desc: Closes remaining gaps, deepens above-the-network services and builds long-term sustainability.
